people.name: Johannes Bronkhorst
people.field: Sanskrit grammar, Buddhist studies and early Buddhism

relations.subject: Johannes Bronkhorst
relations.evidence: Johannes studied Mathematics, Physics, and Astronomy at the Vrije Universiteit in Amsterdam (B.Sc. 1968).

relations.subject: Johannes Bronkhorst
relations.evidence: first to the University of Rajasthan in Jaipur. He completed his MA in 1976.

relations.subject: Johannes Bronkhorst
relations.evidence: He received his PhD from Pune University in 1979 specialising in Sanskrit grammar and Indian philosophy.

relations.subject: Johannes Bronkhorst
relations.evidence: Returning to the Netherlands, he did a second doctorate (1980) at the University of Leiden.

relations.subject: Johannes Bronkhorst
relations.role: Professor of Sanskrit and Indian studies
relations.evidence: He was Professor of Sanskrit and Indian studies at the University of Lausanne from 1987–2011

relations.subject: Johannes Bronkhorst
